nodes.summary: For a codimension-one subspace `S`, the eigenvalues `μₖ` of the compression of a self-adjoint operator `T` interlace the eigenvalues `λₖ` of `T`: `λₖ₊₁ ≤ μₖ ≤ λₖ`.
nodes.title: Cauchy interlacing

nodes.summary: The compression acts by projecting the image back onto the subspace.
nodes.title: Action of the compression of an operator

nodes.summary: The compression of a symmetric operator is symmetric.
nodes.title: Compression of a symmetric operator is symmetric

nodes.summary: The Rayleigh form of the compression at `y` equals the Rayleigh form of the original operator at the underlying vector `(y : E)`.
nodes.title: Rayleigh form of a compression

nodes.summary: The compression of an operator `T` to a subspace `S`: project `T x` orthogonally back onto `S`.
nodes.title: Compression of an operator to a subspace

nodes.summary: The `k`-th eigenvalue of the compression to a codimension-one subspace is at most the `k`-th eigenvalue of the original operator.
nodes.title: Cauchy interlacing, upper half

nodes.summary: The `k`-th eigenvalue of the compression to a codimension-one subspace is at least the `(k+1)`-st eigenvalue of the original operator.
nodes.title: Cauchy interlacing, lower half

nodes.summary: A subspace of dimension `m` can be thinned to a subspace of any smaller dimension.
nodes.title: Subspaces of every smaller dimension inside a given subspace

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
